subject: literacy
concept: Synthesizing multiple texts and sources to support an original literary argument
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student organizes evidence from three different texts into a single argument-support chart
exercise.abstract: Student writes a paragraph synthesizing evidence from multiple texts to support an original literary claim

assessment.mastery_threshold: paragraph integrates evidence from at least two distinct sources in support of one coherent claim
misconception_flags: discusses each source separately rather than genuinely synthesizing them into one unified argument

interest_binding: texts generated fresh from student's stated interest profile where possible
